protocol.command: HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 HIPENGINE_HIP_ARCH=gfx1151 GPU_MAX_HW_QUEUES=1 HIPENGINE_COMPILER_VERSION_FILE=/tmp/laguna_hipcc_version.txt HIPENGINE_REQUIRE_CACHED_BUILD=1 PYTHONPATH=. .venv/bin/python3 -u scripts/laguna_q6_lm_head_top1_leaf.py --candidate paired-tile2 --samples 21 --warmups 5 --burst 8 --compiler-version-file /tmp/laguna_hipcc_version.txt --require-cached-build --output /tmp/laguna-q6-lmhead-tile2-leaf.json
protocol.timing: counterbalanced HIP events over retained producer plus unchanged stage-2 reducer

candidate.description: Pair two independent 16-logit Q6T16 producers in one local256 workgroup. Each 128-thread half preserves the retained K ownership, FMA order, four-wave reduction, FP32 logits, tile maximum, layout, and residency while halving the producer workgroup count.
candidate.red: The focused test failed to import the absent paired-tile wrapper.
candidate.green: The tie-sensitive GPU fixture matched all FP32 logits, top-1 ID, and top-1 value bit-for-bit.

decision.reason: Halving the workgroup count does not reduce weight or arithmetic traffic and slightly worsens the actual-weight leaf. The smaller retained workgroups already expose enough parallelism; the paired scheduling screen was removed completely.
